column1: # Open-class stems, bulk-loaded into %lex Root via `%import lexicon.tsv`.
# Nouns pick a declension paradigm (gender + plural class); verbs pick a
# conjugation. Stems are stored in citation form (the indefinite singular for
# nouns, the present-stem for verbs); the paradigm + spelling cascade derive the
# rest. The seed deliberately omits stems the current paradigms misinflect under
# the boundary-free cascade -- consonant-doubling (rum -> rummet), umlaut plurals
# (bok -> böcker, stad -> städer), t-assimilating adjectives (röd -> rött), and
# e-stem -ar nouns (pojke -> pojkar). Those want dedicated paradigms first.
